cards.goal: Ensure AI systems placed on the EU market are safe and respect fundamental rights, while supporting innovation through regulatory sandboxes and simplified rules for SMEs.
cards.question: Did AI startups in the EU lose ground in venture funding after the AI Act entered into force?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds going to AI startups
cards.not_measured: Compliance costs, product decisions inside companies, and AI adoption by users.
cards.name: AI Act

cards.goal: Ensure hardware and software products with digital elements reach the market with fewer vulnerabilities, with manufacturers responsible for cybersecurity across the product life cycle.
cards.question: Did investors put relatively more into EU cybersecurity startups once new security obligations were set?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds going to cybersecurity startups
cards.not_measured: Whether products actually became more secure. Most obligations apply from December 2027.
cards.name: CRA

cards.goal: Support the development and manufacturing of critical technologies in the EU and reduce the Union's strategic dependencies.
cards.question: Did a larger share of EU venture rounds go to STEP's strategic technology sectors?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds going to STEP sectors (deep tech, AI, semiconductors, clean tech, energy, health tech, defence)
cards.not_measured: Manufacturing capacity and dependency on non-EU suppliers.
cards.name: STEP

cards.goal: Double the EU's share of global semiconductor production to 20% by 2030.
cards.question: Did EU semiconductor startups gain ground in venture funding after the Chips Act?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds going to semiconductor startups
cards.fit_note: The Act's headline target is production capacity (large fabs), which startup funding only partly reflects.
cards.not_measured: Production share, fab investment and supply security.
cards.name: Chips Act

cards.goal: Make decarbonisation a driver of industrial competitiveness and support clean-tech manufacturing.
cards.question: Did EU clean tech and energy startups hold up better than those outside the EU?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds going to clean tech and energy startups
cards.not_measured: Energy prices, industrial output and emissions.
cards.name: Clean Industrial Deal

cards.goal: Build a larger, more integrated EU venture capital market and improve access to growth capital.
cards.question: Are more EU rounds reaching scale-up size (€50M or more)?
cards.indicator: Share of VC rounds of €50M or more (scale-up rounds)
cards.not_measured: Administrative burden, cross-border expansion and institutional investor participation.
cards.name: Startup and Scaleup Strategy
